rows.grounds: fused form of prītaḥ (pleased) and ayam (this)
sarvarakṣāṃ (all protection, accusative), karotu (let him make, imperative), me (for me)

items.question: What protection is sought from the pleased kṣetrapāla?
premises: The kṣetrapāla is pleased by offering.
All protection is requested for the devotee.
items.inference: Therefore the offering secures protective grace.
uncertainties: Token 3 contains multiple words; morphology is summarized.
items.plain_english: Pleased by the offering, may this make all protection for me.
